summary: Completed concealed wall grooving, PVC conduit installation, and back-boxes for main switchboards.
Pulled copper wiring circuits through conduits, completed sub-panel distribution wiring, and grounded earthing line.
Assembled 6 bottom carcass boxes, leveled floor legs, and affixed laminate edge-banding on base cabinets.
Chipped out cracked elbow, solvent-welded new heavy-duty CPVC line, sealed with waterproof compound, tested under 6 bar water pressure with zero leaks.
Cleared first-floor demolition rubble into bags and stacked bricks for masonry work.
